{{Quote|As I said, we board the Vagaari war vessels. Once they've been secured, we'll free the Geroons from their prisons.|[[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]|<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
'''Vagaari warships''' were used by the race of nomadic warriors called the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. The outer hull of these [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were covered with [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] encased within [[zero-g plastic bubble]]s which created a living shield. These warships unsuccessfully faced the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] in the [[Skirmish in the Crustai system]] and the [[Battle of Geroon|battle of the Geroon homeworld]], which simply flew in close enough to fire between the bubbles.
